|quest_reward3_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward3_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Tornado''' is a [[spell]] [[skill]] that creates a tornado which repeatedly damages enemies around it. It will move forward for a duration, during which [[projectile]]s from you (or your skills used by [[proxies]]) can collide with it to deal damage as though it was an enemy. Then it will chase down enemies for a secondary duration, and [[reflect]] a portion of the damage it took from projectiles, in addition to its own spell damage. ==Skill functions and interactions== '''Durations''': During its primary [[duration]], Tornado deals spell damage and can be hit by projectiles. During its secondary duration, Tornado deals both spell damage and [[reflect]]ed damage. Skill effect duration modifiers affect both durations. '''Collisions''': Tornado can only be hit by projectiles that can collide with enemies, meaning skills like {{il|Rolling Magma}} or {{il|Cremation}} cannot contribute to Tornado's reflected damage. Similar to {{il|Hydrosphere}}, projectiles that collide with Tornado may create their on-collision effects, such as {{il|Lightning Arrow}}'s lightning bolts, or {{il|Kinetic Blast}}'s explosions. '''Damage taken''': Tornado is considered to have zero [[resistance]]s, [[evasion]], or [[damage reduction]]. It cannot be [[debuff]]ed, including by [[aura]]s or [[ground effect]]s, though stats like resistance [[penetration]] can still modify the damage calculation.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L6-K1PH0-ps Tornado is never considered an enemy on ''Full Life''https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_m9kWW4AKb4 nor an enemy {{c|mod|that cannot have Life Leeched from them}}.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gXfmMfq2KWw '''Damage reflection''': Reflected damage dealt by Tornado cannot be further scaled by the player's offensive stats, including penetration.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1615527/page/6#p13014218 It can still be modified by lowering enemies' [[mitigation]] through debuffs such as [[exposure]] or [[curse]]s. The damage is no longer considered [[projectile]] damage, and cannot benefit from stats like {{il|Sniper's Mark}}'s {{c|mod|Cursed enemies take % increased Damage from Projectile Hits}}. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Physical
